title: Nice & Easy

services.name: Billiards + Pong Tournament
services.desc: Monday nights just got dirtier at Nice N Easy. We're cranking up the heat with our wild Billiards and Beer Pong tournaments. It's not for the faint-hearted - it's raw, it's rowdy, and it's ridiculously fun. Sink those balls and down those beers as you battle it out for the ultimate bragging rights. Whether you're a seasoned shark or just here for the chaos, we've got a spot for you. And did we mention the loot? Each tournament comes with a grand prize that'll make your heart skip a beat. From scoring Capital tickets to bagging an open bar deal, we're serving victory on a silver platter. So, dust off your cue sticks, practice your pong throw, and get ready for a night of unadulterated fun.

services.name: Open Mic: Comedy Showcase
services.desc: Strap in for a wild night at Nice N Easy on December 6th, from 8:00 PM to 9:30 PM. We're slinging beers and jokes with the notorious Rahmein Mostafavi at the helm of our Open Mic Comedy Night. Expect an unfiltered, uproarious evening crammed with off-the-cuff humor that's as raw as our dive bar vibes. Rahmein, known for his sharp wit and knack for storytelling, is set to keep the laughs rolling and the crowd roaring. His infectious energy promises a night that's anything but dull. Think you've got the guts to tickle some funny bones? Step up, grab the mic and give it a shot. Just here to soak in the comedy mayhem? Grab a beer, kick back, and let the laughs wash over you.
